mapper.sql: SELECT i.*, COALESCE(c.name, s.name) AS partner_name, u.nickname AS create_by_name FROM fin_invoice i LEFT JOIN scm_customer c ON i.kind = 'OUTPUT' AND c.id = i.partner_id LEFT JOIN scm_supplier s ON i.kind = 'INPUT' AND s.id = i.partner_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = i.create_by
mapper.select: SELECT t.*, b.bill_no, b.source_no, b.amount AS bill_amount FROM fin_invoice_item t JOIN fin_bill b ON b.id = t.bill_id WHERE t.invoice_id = #{invoiceId} ORDER BY t.id
mapper.update: UPDATE fin_invoice SET matched_amount = matched_amount + #{amount}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'VALID' AND ABS(matched_amount + #{amount}) <= ABS(amount) AND (matched_amount + #{amount}) * amount >= 0
mapper.select: SELECT b.* FROM fin_bill b WHERE b.kind = #{billKind} AND b.partner_id = #{partnerId} AND b.source_type <> 'MANUAL' AND b.amount <> b.invoiced_amount ORDER BY b.bill_date, b.id

SELECT b.partner_id AS "partnerId", COALESCE(c.name, s.name) AS "partnerName", COUNT(*) AS "billCount", SUM(b.amount) AS "amount", SUM(b.invoiced_amount) AS "invoiced", SUM(b.amount - b.invoiced_amount) AS "uninvoiced", SUM(CASE WHEN b.amount = 0 THEN 0 ELSE (b.amount - b.invoiced_amount) * b.tax_amount / b.amount END) AS "uninvoicedTax" FROM fin_bill b LEFT JOIN scm_customer c ON b.kind = 'AR' AND c.id = b.partner_id LEFT JOIN scm_supplier s ON b.kind = 'AP' AND s.id = b.partner_id WHERE b.kind = #{billKind} AND b.bill_date <= #{asOf} AND b.amount <> b.invoiced_amount AND b.source_type <> 'MANUAL' GROUP BY b.partner_id, COALESCE(c.name, s.name) ORDER BY 6 DESC
